headline: Executive order sets ethics commitments that people appointed to jobs in the federal executive branch must agree to.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Trump, sets ethics commitments for people appointed to positions in the executive branch, such as agency leaders and their senior staff. Only the title was provided, so the specific rules, limits, and penalties are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People appointed to executive branch positions
who_it_affects.how: They are expected to agree to the ethics commitments set out in the order as part of serving in their jobs.
Agencies would be responsible for carrying out the ethics commitments for their appointees.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 28, 2017; the source does not state a separate start date.
